body.label: Effect
body.html: Choose one Exposed creature within weapon range. On a success, deal 1 weapon damage and do not consume Exposed for this Action.

surges.html: The target cannot make Reactions against you until the end of this turn.
Ignore 1 Defense granted by cover or concealment for this Action.

rider.title: AMBUSH CONTINGENCY
rider.html: After resolving this Action, you may establish this Contingency. Trigger: The target moves into or out of cover. Effect: Make the target Exposed.
rider.meta: EXPIRES: START OF YOUR NEXT TURN
